title: PR-IQA: Partial-Reference Image Quality Assessment for Diffusion-Based Novel View Synthesis

layout.note: Three tinted rounded panels side by side, each with a bold lettered title at the top left: grey (a), light blue (b), cream (c). Panel (a) is a vertical chain of boxes joined by black elbow arrows. Panel (b) has a row of three photos above four black-outlined groups of heat maps in a two-by-two arrangement, each under a black header pill. Panel (c) has two small thumbnail rows above a two-by-two grid of renders. No arrows join the panels.

lesson: When methods differ by the inputs they use, group their output tiles in outlined boxes under a black pill that names the inputs, and colour the input words like the frames of the input photos, so the reader sees what each method gets without reading a table.
